title: Task 2: Reconstruct Madness and Objects tables
description:
Objective:
Reconstruct the three Madness effect tables and two Objects statistics tables from extracted SRD lines.

Files:
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseTables.ts
- Test: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseTables.test.ts

Steps:
1. RED: Add SRD-shaped PageText fixtures and assertions for Short-Term Madness (10 rows), Long-Term Madness (12 rows), Indefinite Madness (12 rows), Object Armor Class (7 rows), and Object Hit Points (4 rows): 45 rows total. Assert exact names, columns, values, en-dash ranges, wrapped effect/flaw reflow, numeric AC cells, and source pages.
2. Run: npx vitest run packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseTables.test.ts
Expected: FAIL because parseTables returns none of the five new tables.
3. GREEN: Add narrow anchored parsers. Madness rows begin with a d100 range and accumulate following wrapped lines until the next range/heading; object rows use fixed reviewed regexes bounded by their captions. Add all five results to parseTables before its stable name sort.
4. Re-run the focused test; expect PASS.
5. REFACTOR: Share only helpers that reduce actual duplication, retain fail-closed row shapes, and ensure unrelated lines cannot become rows.
design: Madness tables use columns [d100, Effect] for short/long and [d100, Flaw] for indefinite. Preserve source punctuation and normalize only whitespace introduced by line wrapping. Object Armor Class uses [Substance, AC] with numeric AC. Object Hit Points uses [Size, Fragile, Resilient], keeping examples in the Size cell and HP/dice cells verbatim.
acceptance_criteria:
- parseTables emits all five reviewed tables with exact row counts and source pages.
- Wrapped madness text is joined in reading order without consuming Curing Madness or Objects prose.
- Object parsers reject incomplete/nonmatching rows.
- Focused parseTables tests pass.
notes: Source correction during RED review: Long-Term Madness has 12 rows, making 45 total rows across the five tables.
close_reason: Implemented five anchored, exact-row-count table reconstructors; fixture, pinned-source check, and typecheck pass.
